answer_1.quote: We propose a framework for quickly converting current LLMs into duplex models by processing queries and responses pseudosimultaneously ... MiniCPM-duplex ... enables dynamic responses to user queries.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses in time‑sliced format

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the duplex model with three kinds of metrics: automatic metrics, GPT-4, and human. Automatic metrics, like accuracy and pass rate, are widely used for convenience and low cost.

answer_3.quote: We benchmark it on MT-Bench and MT-Eval with GPT-4 as the judge.

answer_4.quote: When interacting with MiniCPM-duplex... we recruit 14 participants... The questionnaire consists of six questions. The first five questions prompt the user to rate the model based on responsiveness, human-likeness, faithfulness, factuality, and overall experience.
answer_4.guideline: Participants answered a questionnaire rating the model on responsiveness, human‑likeness, faithfulness, factuality, and overall experience (scores 1–7).
